title: Station ticket, version 1
description: The station ticket door (station_ticket/1): a kitchen display reads a kitchen station's tickets, as each Send printed them, and moves each one started, ready, bumped, strictly forward. Called through the partner API (/api/method/ivendnext_mpos.api.v1.station_tickets and .station_ticket_move) under the Retail Permission right station-ticket; the caller must have the store. A Sales Order reaches the kitchen through .sales_order_to_kitchen (right sales-order-kitchen: submit on Sales Order; judged by business_logic/sales_order_kitchen.py, refusals SalesOrderKitchenError and the store's own). Judged by business_logic/station_ticket.py. A refusal's exc_type is its stable code (TicketNotFoundError, TicketStepError, SalesOrderKitchenError, PermissionError, ProfileNotAssignedError, DeviceRequiredError, AssignedProfileDisabledError, DuplicateStoreAssignmentError, StoreAssignmentIncompleteError). After commit, each enabled user of the store whose Retail Permission ticks the right is told {store, station} on the realtime event mpos_station_ticket (the site's socket, namespace /<site name>, signed in with the API key): read the board again.

board_request.description: station_tickets: the store's kitchen board now, one station's or every station's. GET or POST.

board.description: The board: every ticket sent in the last 12 hours and not bumped, and those bumped in the last 30 minutes (a recall), oldest first. There is no cursor: a screen that reconnects reads the board again. Not on the board: a ticket a till printed offline; a send whose printer refused it; a void whose kitchen has no printer. A send ticket the till's print agent reports unprinted leaves it with no notice; its dishes return as a new ticket on the next Send.

ticket.description: One kitchen ticket: kind send (make it) or void (stop making it); source sale (a till's sale), check (a table's or tab's check) or sales_order (a Sales Order sent to the kitchen, added after version 1 first shipped: a screen validating the board against an older copy refuses the whole board while one is on it); call_number is a sale's call number, a check's place or tab name, or the Sales Order's name; till is empty on a Sales Order's ticket; state new until a screen moves it. A void ticket names the dish by item, quantity, guest and course on the same kitchen_order, with no link to the ticket it cancels.

line.description: One line of the ticket. under: the position, in this ticket's lines, of the dish a choice goes under (null for a dish). guest and course: a check's line's (empty on a sale). allergens: the Item fields the store's receipt shows for the item, as the printed ticket carries them.

move_request.description: station_ticket_move: one step forward, new to started to ready to bumped. The same step again is a no-op (already true); a skip or a step back is refused (TicketStepError); another store's ticket, or none, is TicketNotFoundError. POST.

send_order_request.description: sales_order_to_kitchen: a submitted Sales Order's lines to the kitchen's stations, each a ticket on its printer and on the board (source sales_order), only what the kitchen does not have yet. The register is the caller's own at the order's store, or for a caller tied to no store the store's one running register with Kitchen Printers; service_mode is kept only when that register lists it. Refused (SalesOrderKitchenError): no such order; an order not submitted, on hold or closed, of no one store, taken and sent at a till in Order mode, or with nothing new; for a caller tied to no store, a store with no register with Kitchen Printers or several. POST.

call_number.description: The code the expo reads on the ticket, e.g. a courier's pickup code. Left out, the code already on the order's kitchen order stays, else the order's name.

send_order_answer.description: Per station: handed with its ticket number, or failed with the reason (a store setting a manager fixes, or a printer that did not answer: call again, and only what failed is sent). kitchen_order is null when no kitchen took a ticket (nothing is written).
